title: Expedition: logbooks and Grand Expeditions
summary: 0.5.5 made Expedition a core mechanic: run Expedition tablets for logbooks and rare runic monsters, then open Grand Expeditions, which The Quest Continues pushes to up to 3 modifiers.

budget.why: Up to four Expedition Tablets per map (0.5.5 counts) and waystones rolled for two totals (item rarity, monster rarity).
budget.build_needs: Kills rare runic monsters and ice-encased bosses unearthed together by one explosive chain.

claim.note: Our reading of the setup against the budget scale; not measured.

build.why: Each Remnant an explosive destroys applies its modifiers to every monster unearthed after it, so danger stacks along the chain.

claim.note: Our reading of the cited facts against the build scale; not measured.

complexity.why: Plan each explosive chain through the Remnants, then run the logbooks as Grand Expeditions — a second activity the first one feeds.

claim.note: Our reading of the strategy's own steps against the complexity scale; not measured.

yields.why: Runic Monsters drop logbooks; 'of Knowledge', Sown Seeds and Logbook Chance raise it.
Monsters from Verisium Remnants drop Verisium; the 'of Verisium' tablet mod raises it.
Listed among Expedition items; starts a Runic Remnant encounter.

waystone.notes: Rarity totals for unearthed chests and rares; no measured order.

claim.note: Unverified. poe2db counts Expedition monsters as not naturally spawning, and Expedition has its own 'Expedition Monster Rarity' tablet stat, so the waystone's monster rarity may not reach runic monsters. The waystone rarity line reads 'Rarity of Items found in this Area' (RePoE), which would cover excavated chests, but no source confirms it; test in game.

steps: Allocate The Quest Continues and Sown Seeds, then Logbook Chance, Gaining Traction and Double or Nothing (25% option).
Set Hilda: Scarred Lands and Ancient Inscriptions; T2 and T4 are free picks.
Slot Expedition Tablets (0.5.5: 1 adds an Expedition; 2 add a Verisium Remnant and 35% density; 3 another Expedition; 4 another Remnant and density).
Chain explosives through Remnants before the rares; run logbooks as Grand Expeditions.
risks: Expedition Tablets cannot be obtained in the Runes of Aldur league (0.5.5 patch notes) — Forbidden Rites and Standard only.
Remnant modifiers also make the unearthed monsters harder.
